% Real PDF fixture: two distinct running marks survive sequential assessments.
% Both parities, plain pages, automatic blanks and chapter openers are covered.
\documentclass[11pt,twoside,openright]{book}
\input{config/book-config.tex}
\newif\ifBookTwoInkProof
\ifdefined\PageStylesPrint
  \BookTwoInkProoftrue
\else
  \BookTwoInkProoffalse
\fi
\newif\ifPrintThreeInk
\PrintThreeInkfalse
\usepackage{styles/universalbook}
% Observe both transient marks at shipout, without changing the production
% header or depending on marks from the previously shipped page.
\newif\ifFixtureProbeMarks
\FixtureProbeMarkstrue
\newsavebox{\FixtureBackHeaderBox}
\newsavebox{\FixtureDepthHeaderBox}
\AddToHook{shipout/foreground}{%
  \ifFixtureProbeMarks
    \put(20mm,-220mm){\makebox[0pt][l]{\BookHeaderTitleFont\color{BookInk}%
      LMPROBE\space\leftmark\space RMPROBE\space\rightmark}}%
  \fi
}
% Zero-size overlay: exposes both actual text-block edges in the PDF without
% affecting paragraph width, vertical spacing or the fixture's page count.
\newcommand{\FixtureBodyFrame}{%
  \noindent\begin{tikzpicture}[overlay]
    \draw[BookInk,line width=.2pt]
      (0,-1mm)--(0,1mm)
      (0,0)--(\linewidth,0)
      (\linewidth,-1mm)--(\linewidth,1mm);
  \end{tikzpicture}%
}
\begin{document}
% Logical cassette dimensions include the transparent margin around the ink.
% The vector ink itself therefore need not occupy the full 6.4 mm height.
\begingroup
\BookHeaderTitleFont
\setbox0=\hbox{\BookHeaderIcon}%
\typeout{HEADERICONMETRICS:\the\wd0:\the\ht0:\the\dp0}%
\endgroup
\setcounter{chapter}{1}
% Exercise the standard chaptermark route, then give the transient marks
% deliberately different values from the stored running chapter title. Set
% both the first and last page marks so leftmark/rightmark have known values.
\markboth{ORIGINALLEFT}{ORIGINALRIGHT}
% Exercise the book flags for unnumbered chapters without adding pages.
% Cache the public rendered label before restoring the ordinary chapter.
\makeatletter
\begingroup
\@mainmatterfalse
\chaptermark{BACKCHAPTER}
\global\setbox\FixtureBackHeaderBox=\hbox{\BookHeaderTitleFont\BookHeaderUnitLabel}%
\endgroup
\begingroup
\c@secnumdepth=-1\relax
\chaptermark{DEPTHCHAPTER}
\global\setbox\FixtureDepthHeaderBox=\hbox{\BookHeaderTitleFont\BookHeaderUnitLabel}%
\endgroup
\makeatother
\chaptermark{INITIALCHAPTER}
\markboth{ORIGINALLEFT}{ORIGINALRIGHT}
\FixtureBodyFrame
BODYNORMALONE
\clearpage
\FixtureBodyFrame
BODYNORMALTWO
\begin{Assessment}{ASSESSMENTONE}
BODYFIRSTONE
\newpage
BODYFIRSTTWO
\end{Assessment}
BODYAFTERFIRST
\clearpage
\begin{Assessment}{ASSESSMENTTWO}
BODYSECONDONE
\newpage
BODYSECONDTWO
\end{Assessment}
BODYAFTERSECOND
\clearpage
% A subsequent ordinary markright must retain the original left component.
\markright{NEXTRIGHT}
BODYAFTERMARKRIGHT
\clearpage
BODYMARKRIGHTEVEN
\clearpage
\FixtureProbeMarksfalse
\thispagestyle{plain}
BODYPLAIN
\clearpage
% At this point the next page is even: cleardoublepage must insert an empty
% verso rather than accidentally retaining a running header or a page number.
\cleardoublepage
\BookChapter{CHAPTEROPENER}{BODYCHAPTER}{\item A short fixture goal.}
\FixtureProbeMarkstrue
\WorksheetOpening{Fixture}{Worksheet title}
BODYAFTERCHAPTER
\clearpage
\FixtureProbeMarksfalse
\thispagestyle{empty}
BODYEXPLICITEMPTY
% A reference at the same nominal size lets PDF tests compare ink bounds
% independently of the running-header placement, without adding a page.
\par\vspace{8mm}
\noindent{\BookHeaderTitleFont\BookHeaderIcon}
\par\noindent{\BookHeaderTitleFont BACKPROBE\space\usebox{\FixtureBackHeaderBox}}
\par\noindent{\BookHeaderTitleFont DEPTHPROBE\space\usebox{\FixtureDepthHeaderBox}}
% The photo route starts on a recto and must refresh the stored chapter label.
\BookChapterPhoto{PHOTOCHAPTER}{BODYPHOTOCHAPTER}{chapter_photo}{Fixture credit}{\item A short photo fixture goal.}
\FixtureProbeMarkstrue
\begin{Assessment}{ASSESSMENTFINAL}
BODYFINALASSESSMENT
\end{Assessment}
\end{document}
